items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: this was Duke Ellington with Rex Stewart and Johnny Hodges was it.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh and idea I got from that minimalist thing of getting a little bit to sound like a lot was a bass player we worked with years ago with an old incarnation of this band, Dave Lanyardo. He lent me this album and it was late 30s sort of Duke Ellington, small group stuff. I was never into that big band game really, but this was Duke Ellington with Rex Stewart and Johnny Hodges was it.
